we have found a new method to compute t-analag of quantum characters of quantum groups and we have computed the t-analog of quantum character of all l-fudamental representations of quantum affine algebrass of type E 6, 7, 8 by a supercomputer and proved the fermionic formula conjectured by Hatyama et al.
we compute t-analgs of q-characters for all l-fundamntal representations of quantum affine algebrs of types E 1, E 2, E 3, E 4, E 5, E 6, respectively.

the t-analogs (and q- characters) of Kirillov– Reshetikhin modules of the quantum affine algebra of type \({{E}_{6}^{{(1)}}}\) are given by fermionic formulas, and that these fermionic formulas are also valid for the quantum affine algrebras of types \({{E}_{{7}}^{{(1})}}\) and \({{E}^{{(8)}}}\).
In summary, our research is concerned with

the computation of the t-analogs and fermionic formulas for the q-characters of Kirillov– Reshetikhin modules and fundamental representations of quantum affine alge-bra of type E 6,7,8, and the monomial realization and the irreducible components of lagrangian subvari-eties of quiver varieties.
the study of the representation theory of the quantum affine algebra of type E 6, 7, 8 and the crystal bases of the corresponding fundamental representation of quantum group of type E 8.

the computation of Betti numbers and determination of irreducible components of lagrangian submanifolds of quiver varieties, which are the geometric interpretation of the t-analogs and q-characters of quantum groups. t-Analogs and q-Characters of Finite and Affine Symmetric Groups.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the t-analogs and the fermionic formulae of the q-characters of the Kirillov– Reshetikhin modules of the quantum affine algebra of types \({E}_{1}^{(1)}, {E}_{7}^{{(1)}}, {E}_{8}^{{(}1)}\) have been obtained.
we have determined the irreducible components of all lagrangian subvariety of all the quiver varieties of the finite type Lie algebras.

we have obtained the fermionic formulas for all irreducible highest weight modules of the quantum affine algebra of type E 8, which is the most complicated case in all types of quantum affine algebra.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we compute t-analogue of q-character of all l-fundymental representations of the quantum loop algebra of type E 6, 7, 8.
we have computed the Betti numbers of all irreducible l-fundamental modules of quantum affine algebrass of types A n, B n, C n, D n, E 6, E 7, E 8.
we have determined the Betti numbers of the quiver varieties of all types of finite dimensional simple Lie algebras.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use the quantum affine algebraic approach to study the finite dimensional quantum group.
the fermionic formula is valid for Kirillov-Reshetikhin representations of quantum affine algebrass of all types.
the fermionic formula holds for the Kirillov– Reshetikhin modules of quantum affine alge-bra of types E 7, \({E}_{9}\) and E 10, which were not covered in the previous work.
